|---|---:|

Build evidence snapshot · 2026-10-16. Other surfaces have test evidence but no consolidated executable-line report.

## How to read this dashboard

- 🟢 **Strong** — broad automated evidence
- 🟠 **Partial** — meaningful evidence with known gaps
- 🔵 **Observed** — runtime or dependency evidence only
- 🔴 **Weak** — important gap

Live PromQL activity overrides the fill intensity for instrumented nodes. Architecture and evidence remain source-controlled; operations remain live in Grafana.
